body:
Translated from Hindi. This is a short notice; its text follows.

Air-quality readings in Delhi NCR have gone past 450. This is called the 'severe' (गंभीर) level.

Classes at Delhi's primary schools are now running online. Schools in Noida and Gurugram (गुरुग्राम) will stay open.

Building work has reportedly stopped, and diesel trucks have reportedly been kept out of Delhi.

More information: https://example.com/sources/delhi-schools-clarification

Translator's notes: "Reportedly" translates the Hindi for "it is being reported". Nothing has been added to the notice.
